# AI Usage Report

## 1. AI tools used
ChatGPT was used to help plan the project structure, draft starter code, explain the frontend/backend/database connection, and review validation and CRUD logic.

## 2. Important prompts
- "Build a beginner-friendly full-stack student marketplace that meets the assessment guide."
- "Explain the purpose of each API endpoint and how the frontend calls it."
- "Help identify test cases for Create, Read, Update and Delete."

## 3. Features or code generated with AI
AI assistance was used for the initial HTML layout, CSS styling, client-side JavaScript, Express API routes, SQLite table setup, validation, and project documentation.

## 4. Changes I made to AI-generated code
I made changes to the code the AI added changing the name of the app and reomving some unwanted features

## 5. Errors and how I resolved them
I encountered errors in editing some of my codes but with AI and the guidance of my instructors i was able to solve them.

## 6. How I tested and verified AI-generated code
I tested it by creating a listing, seeing if it works and information is saved, seeing if i could edit it after publishing, and seeing if i can delete it if necessary.

## 7. What I learned
I learnt that there are alot of ups and dowons when it comes to coding but with critical thinking and perseverance and a little guidance alot can be achieved especially even as a beginner.
